paragraph: An agent that controls HOOMD-blue in words for a fluid of Hookean dumbbells in an implicit solvent, the molecular model whose stress the Oldroyd-B equation describes: asked for the fluid's viscoelastic properties, it runs the dumbbells' Brownian dynamics on the settings the person gives, has library skills compute the relaxation time and the polymer viscosity from the stress HOOMD-blue reports, takes both out of HOOMD-blue's own units through the scales the person confirmed, and writes the two as one hand-over card in its outbox for the CFD agent, each with its source, its grade and the run's conditions. The solvent viscosity is the person's to give to the CFD agent. It never carries the card itself.

tool_reading.claim: HOOMD-blue adopts no system of units: it follows a self-consistent one on three base units, energy, length and mass, from which time, force and pressure are derived
loci: Units, sections Base Units and Unit Conversion (mat-20261120-hoomd-7.2.2-units)

tool_reading.claim: md.bond.Harmonic gives each bond the energy U(r) = k (r - r0)^2 / 2, with k the potential constant in energy per length squared and r0 the rest length, set per bond type in params

md.methods.Brownian integrates the overdamped Langevin equation on a particle filter at a temperature kT (energy) with a translational drag coefficient gamma per particle type (mass per time), the random force sized by the fluctuation-dissipation theorem; its error is first order in the time step
loci: hoomd.md.methods.Brownian, the equations of motion, the parameters and the warning (mat-20261121-hoomd-7.2.2-methods-brownian)
tool_reading.limitations: no hydrodynamic interaction between particles is stated, and none is in the dumbbell model either

tool_reading.claim: md.compute.ThermodynamicQuantities reports pressure_tensor, six components xx, xy, xz, yy, yz, zz, each the kinetic sum plus the net virial of the integrator's forces over the volume, in pressure units; under Brownian the velocities are drawn each step at the set temperature
tool_reading.limitations: a pressure is positive in compression: a stress read from it carries the opposite sign

tool_reading.claim: HOOMD-blue computes the virial and the pressure only on steps where a GSD writer or an NPT integrator needs them unless Simulation.always_compute_pressure is set; read between them, pressure_tensor is not a number
loci: the run adapter's first trial under TMPDIR, every logged component not a number, and its second, finite with the flag set (failure bd-1)

tool_reading.claim: the run adapter, tried under TMPDIR with hoomd from conda-forge, ran Brownian dynamics of Hookean dumbbells and logged the xy, xz and yz components of the pressure tensor with the box volume; passed through autocorrelation_of_series, shear_relaxation_modulus_green_kubo and exponential_decay_fit they gave a relaxation time and a viscosity near the dumbbell relations' for the trial's settings (evidence for the adapter only; no value of it enters a card)
loci: the adapter's third trial under TMPDIR, result.json and run.log of its run folder
tool_reading.limitations: the first trial, a tenth as long, gave a decay time well off the relation's: how long a run must be for a given precision is not settled, and the uncertainty of the Green-Kubo estimate is not yet computed by any skill

contract.name: run_dumbbell_bd
contract.description: run HOOMD-blue's Brownian dynamics, md.methods.Brownian, on Hookean dumbbells in an implicit solvent: two beads joined by md.bond.Harmonic with zero rest length, no force between dumbbells, the dumbbells' centres on a simple cubic grid in a cubic box; after the equilibration steps it logs the off-diagonal components of the pressure tensor every sample_every steps; every value is in HOOMD-blue's own units, whose scales envelope/handovers.json records; a new folder under runs/bd for each run; it returns what HOOMD-blue reports and computes nothing from it

n_dumbbells.description: how many dumbbells, each two beads joined by a Hookean spring

box_side.description: the side of the cubic box

spring_k.description: the spring's constant K of md.bond.Harmonic, whose rest length is zero

initial_separation.description: how far apart the two beads of each dumbbell start, along x

bead_mass.description: each bead's mass; Brownian dynamics moves the beads without inertia

bead_drag.description: each bead's drag coefficient zeta, md.methods.Brownian's gamma

equilibration_steps.description: how many steps run before anything is logged

steps.description: how many steps are logged after equilibration, a whole number of samples

sample_every.description: how many steps between two logged samples

seed.description: the random seed of the Brownian forces

budget_s.description: the running time the run may take before the call gives up on it, counted while it runs and not while it is paused; no limit when null

steps_run.description: how many steps were logged after equilibration

kinetic_temperature.description: the kinetic temperature HOOMD-blue reports at the end, as an energy

bond_energy.description: the springs' energy HOOMD-blue reports at the end

thermostat_kT.description: the thermal energy md.methods.Brownian held, read back from HOOMD-blue

integrator_dt.description: the integrator's step, read back from HOOMD-blue

sample_interval.description: the engine time between two logged samples: the integrator's step times sample_every

pressure_tensor_offdiagonal.description: three series in the order xy, xz, yz: the off-diagonal components of md.compute.ThermodynamicQuantities.pressure_tensor, the stress of the springs and the beads' motion, in HOOMD-blue's energy per volume, logged every sample_every steps at equilibrium

run_dir.description: the run's folder, relative to this directory

inputs.description: the call's inputs, the conditions the run held under

safety_gate.place: src/gate.py, consulted by src/run_tool.py before the call
